landed: A-spec-2 (house_sim/kernel/realism.py): Realism.dump() holds the observation log ('observed': record flag, items, stamps, evidence snapshots) whenever recording is on or anything was recorded, and 'track_moves': false when that switch is off; Realism.load() restores the ObservationLog exactly and record_observations as saved (a dump without the key restores an empty log, recording off). A run forked through env.save / HouseEnv.load now judges reports, acts and claims on the evidence perceived before the snapshot and keeps judging new claims (p_fork_claim: forked founded True with 5 observations, was False / 0; p_fork_say: forked founded False, said False, ['perceive:claim_unperceived:1'], was None / True / [])

A-gaming-1 (house_sim/tasks/perceive.py): Index.told(value, before_step, subject=None) reads only a person's own words (Index.person_statements): heard messages and the REPLY_KEYS answer fields (value, said, picked, answer, reply, refers_to) of a JSON reply naming who answered ('by' a person); never a speech command's message (the robot's own words echoed), a report / call / alert receipt, the fields carrying the question back (about, aspect, detail, key, topic, options) or 'by'; a stretch of ECHO_WORDS (3) or more of the robot's own words in a row, or two or more candidates of one list the robot offered (ask options), is masked; replies to a question naming only other things do not tell a fact about the subject (supports passes subject=eid). r3_told: told(sam/ann/mia) False and supports None after the robot's own question; r4_report_gating: perceive:report_unperceived:mug_1.owner with and without the robot's speech

A-gaming-4 (house_sim/tasks/perceive.py, house_sim/kernel/realism.py): act_gaps(..., agent=False) and agent_labels -> act_gaps(agent=True); for an agent a branch is also decided by any successful command that does what an effectful branch diff command does (_does_what): placement (the act log's new 'placed' {id: location}, from the world journal, shows the diff deposit's target put at its destination, whatever the verb) or role (same effect kind -- report / deposit (DEPOSIT class or an EFFECT naming a destination) / effect --, same target and destination, no shared argument with another value). Perception, navigation, speech, waits, refused commands, pick_up of the thing, deposits elsewhere and settings to other values decide nothing; the reference rule stays exact. r8c_branch_bypass 0 1 3: 'raw approach + stack' on intact seeds 0 and 3 fails with perceive:branch_unperceived:intact (was fails=False); r8_branch_gate 0 1 3: every reference passes and is gated_ok, every blind policy fails

deviations.what: A-gaming-4: decisive agent acts are matched by effect kind + target + destination and by where the act put the thing, derived inside perceive from the diff set WP5 already passes, not by 'any EFFECT / DEPOSIT / report whose target or destination plays a role a diff command names (or the branch evidence names)' with a role-level set from WP5
deviations.why: taken literally, fetching the branch's thing is decisive (pick_up(book) names the diff place's target and is common to every branch), so every reference and every legitimate agent that picks the thing up before inspecting it would fail; the narrower rule closes stack / insert / throw / tidy and other verbs without that false positive and needs no WP5 change

deviations.what: the reference rule (act_gaps default, called by WP5's reference_run / mode_trials) keeps exact matching of the reference's own diff commands
deviations.why: 15.3 defines the reference's decisive commands as its branch diff set, which consists of its own commands, so exact matching is complete for it; the verb freedom the finding exploits is the agent's

deviations.what: A-gaming-1 goes beyond the suggested fix: the reply's 'by' (who answered) founds nothing and replies are scoped to the report's subject
deviations.why: before, asking Mia anything founded owner = mia through '"by": "mia"' in the ask's message, and an ask about another thing founded this thing's owner; both are the same leak class (words that are not the person's answer about this thing)

not_done.what: told() is still lexical inside a person's words: a reply mentioning a name for another reason ('That's not my request; ask Sam.') founds it for a question about this thing or about nothing in particular, and heard messages carry no subject
not_done.why: a semantic owner / intent claim parser is WP4's speech domain; the review's leak (the robot's own words, echoes, offered candidates) is closed; noted as a known gap

not_done.what: outcome matching for diff commands without a destination or for liquids (put(milk -> bin) for a dispose(milk) diff; dump(jug) for pour(jug -> sink))
not_done.why: the diff set WP5 passes carries the reference's commands, not their outcomes; requested from WP5 (each diff command's step outcome), after which _does_what can match by outcome

requests: WP5: give each branch-diff command (verify.branch_diff_sets) the outcome of its step in the reference -- e.g. the reference act log's 'placed' for that step, or the fields the step changed -- as an optional key, so perceive's agent rule can match an agent act by outcome for destination-less deposits and liquid transfers; perceive.act_gaps keeps its signature (agent rule via agent_labels, reference rule via act_gaps default).
